commit_message:
[13.x] Fix two out-of-sync table of contents labels (#11353)

Two table of contents labels did not match the heading and anchor they link to.

- eloquent.md: the entry read "Chunk Using Lazy Collections" while the section heading, its anchor, and two in-page links all read "Chunking Using Lazy Collections".
- passport.md: the entry read "Creating a Device Code Grant Client" while the section heading and anchor read "Creating a Device Authorization Grant Client", matching the parent "Device Authorization Grant" entry.

Only the label text changed. The anchors are untouched, so no links break.
